title: James Baldwin on How Love (Finally) Finds You
author: Maria Popova
summary: Our language betrays our self-betrayals: We speak of finding love, as if it were an undiscovered eighth continent or a habitable world in another solar system, as if it got lost like the Little Red Riding Hood or the names of the women who painted the caves.
